summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue up to $115,000,000 in bonds for repair, safety, and upgrade projects at Reed, Bel Aire, and Del Mar schools, repaid by a property tax.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes bonds and a property tax levy to fund school facility repairs and upgrades.
tax.quote: If approved by local voters, Measure O would authorize up to $115 million in bonds and levy up to $30 per $100,000 of assessed (not market) value while the bonds are outstanding.
